description: Create Prometheus alerting rules, Grafana dashboard, and K8s deployment configs. Create deploy/prometheus/alerts.yaml with WorkerGroupDown, WorkerHighErrorRate, WorkerColdStartSlow, GatewayCircuitOpen rules. Create deploy/grafana/dashboards/flow-workers.json with request rate, latency percentiles, error rate, replica count, cold start, circuit breaker panels. Update deployment template with security hardening. Create deploy/k8s/network-policies.yaml for worker isolation.
steps: Create deploy/ directory structure: deploy/prometheus/, deploy/grafana/dashboards/, deploy/k8s/

Create deploy/prometheus/alerts.yaml with Prometheus alerting rules group 'flow-workers' containing: WorkerGroupDown (sum(up{job='flow-worker',group='...'}) == 0 for 1m, severity critical), WorkerHighErrorRate (rate(worker_requests_total{status='error'}[5m]) > 0.1 for 5m, severity warning), WorkerColdStartSlow (histogram_quantile(0.95, gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds) > 10 for 5m, severity warning), GatewayCircuitOpen (gateway_circuit_breaker_state == 1 for 1m, severity critical)

Create deploy/grafana/dashboards/flow-workers.json with panels: Request Rate per Group (sum by group rate(gateway_requests_total[5m])), Latency Percentiles (histogram_quantile 0.5, 0.95, 0.99), Error Rate per Group, Replica Count over Time (gateway_worker_replicas), Cold Start Duration (gateway_cold_start_duration_seconds), Circuit Breaker State (gateway_circuit_breaker_state), Scale Operations Timeline (gateway_scale_operations_total)

Update engine/internal/gateway/templates/deployment.yaml.tmpl to add securityContext block: spec.template.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 1000, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities.drop: [ALL]

Create deploy/k8s/network-policies.yaml with NetworkPolicy 'worker-isolation' selecting app: flow-worker, policyTypes: [Ingress, Egress], ingress: from podSelector app: engine, egress: to podSelector app: postgres-engine and app: engine
Update engine/internal/gateway/manifests.go ManifestConfig to include SecurityContext fields
Update engine/internal/gateway/manifests_test.go to verify security context is rendered
Validate JSON syntax of Grafana dashboard by parsing it
acceptance_criteria: deploy/grafana/dashboards/flow-workers.json is valid JSON and importable into Grafana
Generated deployment.yaml from templates includes securityContext with all hardening settings
verification: cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase5 && kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f deploy/prometheus/alerts.yaml 2>&1 || echo 'kubectl validation (dry-run)'
cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/dynamic-workers-phase5 && kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f deploy/k8s/network-policies.yaml 2>&1 || echo 'kubectl validation (dry-run)'
findings: All deployment configs and security hardening implemented successfully. kubectl not available in CI but YAML validated via Python yaml parser. Created 6 Prometheus alerting rules (WorkerGroupDown, WorkerHighErrorRate, WorkerColdStartSlow, GatewayCircuitOpen, GatewayQueueBacklog, GatewayHighLatency), comprehensive Grafana dashboard with 12 panels and variable templating, network policies for worker isolation and engine gateway, and security context hardening (runAsNonRoot, readOnlyRootFilesystem, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, drop ALL capabilities).
